title: docs(qa): document the area-level `fixtures` recipe convention in the platform-checklist README
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#7716

Linkage chore from PR #7716 (#7670), filed by the devx PM per the accepted option B on that PR's open question.

## Task

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md`'s "Item anatomy" documents `fixtures` only per-item. PR #7716 introduced an **area-level `fixtures` block** (a named provisioning recipe, e.g. `qa-scratch-authz` in `areas/attachments-storage.json`) that items opt into via `fixtures.provisioning = { use, why }`. Document both halves of that convention in README.md's Item anatomy so the next area that needs a shared recipe copies a documented shape instead of reverse-engineering the first one.

Deliberately deferred (option C on the same question): teaching `check-platform-checklist.mjs` to resolve `fixtures.provisioning.use` against the area's `fixtures` keys — revisit only if the recipe shape spreads to more areas.

## Provenance

- #7670 (the fixture card) → PR #7716 (the recipe) → its report's open_questions[0], option B accepted at review.

No `domain:*` label — routing is the triage seat's. `pm:blocked` omitted in favor of the `Blocked-by:` line + `pm:queue` since #7716 is expected to merge within the hour; if selection reaches this card first, the line above defers it.
